import pandas as pd
import sys

def adjust_percentages(csv_path):
    # Read the CSV file
    df = pd.read_csv(csv_path)

    # Adjust percentages based on row index
    for index in range(len(df)):
        if index % 2 == 0:  # Even row
            df.iloc[index, 1] += 5  # Assuming percentages are in the second column
        else:  # Odd row
            df.iloc[index, 1] -= 5

    # Save the adjusted DataFrame back to CSV
    df.to_csv(csv_path, index=False)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    if len(sys.argv) != 2:
        print("Usage: python format.py <path_to_csv>")
        sys.exit(1)
    adjust_percentages(sys.argv[1])
